summary: Iteration 53 — Social.docx #5 fix: new AdminDriverApplications page. Backend (10/10 pytest) and Frontend (all UI flows) PASS. Sidebar link, /admin/driver-applications route, 5 bucket tabs, drawer (open/close), onboarding empty-state message, approve flow, reject flow, filters, and search all work correctly. Backend contract for /api/admin/drivers list + approve + reject (with 409 guards for onboarding, 404 for unknown driver) verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Approve/Reject action panel supports transitions beyond spec: e.g., an already-approved driver shows a 'Reject' button (approved -> rejected). This matches backend behaviour and is intentional per contract, but the review request only names approve/reject from pending_review. Consider hiding action buttons for approved drivers if product intent is 'one-shot review only', or add an explicit 'suspend' verb which is missing (Suspended bucket tab exists with no way to reach it from the UI).

The 'notes' field is described in spec as 'required for rejection' but the frontend allows empty submission (backend also allows Optional[str]). Consider making it required client-side for reject to enforce the reviewer-notes convention.

AdminDriverApplications.jsx is 337 lines and self-contained (DetailCard/Row/ImgLink defined at bottom) — fine for now; if you add another admin page needing the same cards, extract to /components/admin/DetailCard.jsx.
